items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And when he and Pearl Wong opened this club twelve years ago they didn’t know what they were going to do on weeknights.

ctx.x: I think I’ve seen your name.

I’m there three nights a week. He just gave it to me. You know I started out, I worked for this Sonny Buxton, who is somebody you should talk to I think maybe. Anyway Sonny is a very interesting man. He had a former club called Milestones. I worked there. And when he and Pearl Wong opened this club twelve years ago they didn’t know what they were going to do on weeknights. On weekends they knew what they wanted to do. So I started playing, taking a little trio in there on weeknights. And it was sort of week to…
Oh I like those kind of gigs. I have one at home actually.
